title: Linguistic Patterns in Pandemic-Related Content: A Comparative Analysis of COVID-19, Constraint, and Monkeypox Datasets
reasoning: The study focuses on linguistic and rhetorical analysis (readability, punctuation, and keyword frequency) of pandemic-related misinformation. While it discusses the use of 'moral appeals' as a rhetorical strategy to increase engagement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious faith, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks.
